svg.text: ● runs as is · ◐ runs differently · — not stated

g.text: GATE CONTRACTS · PARENT-OWNED · ONE RULE EACH
missing, mutable or unverifiable evidence → STOP
dispatch never adds nodes, owners or deps
needs response=approve; denied or stale → STOP
one fixed wave; never a later dynamic wave
no dependent work before the complete join
hash, path, ownership or verifier mismatch → FAIL
requested mode or spawn count never suffices
conflict, scope change or drift → new plan
serial gates; failed or missing gate → FAIL
missing QA/challenger pass may withhold completion
helper auto picks portable only when derived
parallel-write and unpromoted modes fail closed
non-sensitive · network restricted · approval neverfilesystem_isolation=unverified · no external events

1 · plan frozen before dispatch; no nodes added later2 · node eligible only when fully hash-bound3 · downstream waits for every dependency join4 · parallel = observed overlap, never a request5 · parent reconciles serially, deterministically6 · unsafe parallel → same plan as serial-fallback7 · no flag, env var or child grants write authority8 · evidence minimized; telemetry HMACs runtime IDs

svg.text: child edits only declared paths, never commits · parent re-derives patches · rollback-ambiguous stops

g.text: v3 portable policy, read-only, restricted, never
user approval after five-field brief; 1 attempt
auto, env, read or paid approval
schema-v1 reads only; promotion needs schema-v3
Sensitive task or no frozen policy
report unavailable; stay portable or serialize
no concurrent dispatch; re-plan or serialize
stop dispatch; serially re-plan unstarted nodes
Missing terminal, output, verifier or join
block node + dependents; no parallel claim
Recovery stays inside the frozen plan
Retry ≤1 per node, only timeout · transport_error · rate_limited; never deterministic, conflict or drift.
Cancel: stop new dispatch, keep cancel_requested until a real terminal event; never integrate partial writes.
Rollback: disable opt-in → serial-fallback, same plan digest; keep evidence + worktrees; never replay nodes.
Maintainer architecture reference (replaces the retired prose doc); update it with any gate, tier, approval or lifecycle change.
